findings.source_quote: τοὺς ἀπὸ ἑαυτῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν εὑρεῖν νομίσαντας
findings.english_quote: those who thought they could discover the truth by themselves
findings.issue: The draft selects a contextual capacity/prospective interpretation without disclosing the material retrospective alternative. The bare aorist infinitive εὑρεῖν after νομίσαντας also supports, more directly, people who supposed they had discovered the truth. Unlike 2.7, this clause does not explicitly contain δύνασθαι εὑρεῖν. The prospective reading need not be rejected solely because another reading is available, but its rationale and the alternative must be preserved.
findings.suggested_revision: Compare the draft explicitly with 'those who supposed they had discovered the truth on their own.' Either propose that more source-transparent rendering with an explanatory note, or explain why the context supports retaining the prospective wording and preserve the retrospective alternative in a note. Revised wording or notes require fresh review.

findings.issue: The image-checked edition contains an explicit gap after νομίσαντας, leaving the announced finding without its missing continuation. The draft correctly preserves the seven periods and acknowledges the publication block. Complete coverage of the supplied surviving wording does not recover the absent meaning. This block concerns genuinely missing source content, not uncertain grammar, an alleged OCR error, or the existence of competing interpretations.
findings.suggested_revision: Retain the seven-period gap and the publication block. Documentary textual evidence identifying the absent continuation would be needed before considering any separately identified restoration. Further verification of the already checked print alone cannot recover it. Do not invent a continuation or silently import another edition's wording into the selected text; any restoration proposal requires fresh review.
